path_story.name: Bridge request through payment and reconciliation
path_story.description: Illustrative federal lifecycle in a 330,000-sat city-scale experiment. Includes optional T7; skips adjustment. No chain transactions executed.

annotations.Task_Formulate: Prepare the request and supporting narrative before the budget year. No blockchain transaction.
annotations.Task_OpenPR: Git supplies the document history and line-item diff. No transaction.
annotations.Task_Review: Structured review summary and comments, with an agency response. No transaction.
annotations.Task_Merge: Merge approves this planning document version; it does not enact an appropriation.
annotations.Task_Propose: Publish the proposal; it does not establish spending authority. No transaction.
annotations.Task_Congress: Official legislation is the source of authority, independent of the experimental chain.
annotations.Task_Authority: T1: 330,000 → 10,000 bridge program + 320,000 other city budget. Record the independently enacted authority and its source. The federal example is scaled inside the city experiment.
annotations.Task_Apportion: T2: 10,000 → 2,500 apportioned + 7,500 unapportioned. The period limit refers to the original authority and its conditions.
annotations.Task_Allot: T3: 2,500 → 1,000 district + 1,500 unallotted. Check purpose, amount, and approvals before recording the allotment.
annotations.Task_Obligate: T4: 1,000 → 750 obligated + 250 district/unobligated. The contract remains in its authoritative system; evidence links the obligation to the allotment.
annotations.Task_Accept: Accept actual work before approving the invoice. No blockchain transaction.
annotations.Task_Pay: Actual payment happens in the financial system. The next task attests its record.
annotations.Task_PartialReceipt: T5: 750 → 500 paid + 250 obligated/unpaid. Attest the financial-system payment after work acceptance and reconciliation. Marker sats remain in demo custody.
annotations.Task_FinalAccept: Later work acceptance, after the current live snapshot.
annotations.Task_FinalPay: Actual final payment stays in the financial system.
annotations.Task_FinalReceipt: T6: 250 obligated/unpaid → 250 paid. This is a later event, beyond the live dashboard snapshot. The final payment occurs in the financial system.
annotations.Task_Reconcile: Reconcile the $750K contract. Account closeout follows its own availability rules.
annotations.Task_Checkpoint: T7: 500 paid + 250 paid → 750 reconciled. Optional checkpoint. Paid markers stay historical; reconciliation does not release fresh budget authority.
